class.name: TrenchbroomDefaults
class.brief_description: Utility for Blazium Trenchbroom module default assets and settings.
class.description: Resolves the external [code]trenchbroom_defaults[/code] repo via [code]blazium/trenchbroom/defaults_path[/code] and provides factory methods for default FGD, map settings, and game config resources.

method.name: create_default_fgd
method.description: Loads or builds the default bundled FGD resource.

method.name: create_default_game_config
method.description: Loads or builds the default TrenchBroom game config preset.

method.name: create_default_map_settings
method.description: Loads or builds default map settings from the defaults repo.

method.name: ensure_default_assets
method.description: Creates missing palette, texture, and icon files in the defaults directory.

method.name: get_defaults_dir
method.description: Returns the project defaults directory from ProjectSettings.

method.name: resolve_defaults_path
method.description: Resolves a relative path against the configured defaults directory.
